steps: Bring your instrument or gear to a Guitar Center store
Get paid same-day: up to $1,000 cash, larger amounts by check
timing: Same-day payment after in-store inspection: up to $1,000 cash, larger totals by check.
who_pays: Guitar Center - the store pays you directly for your instrument or gear.
who_qualifies: You must own the instrument or gear, and you need to visit a Guitar Center store in person.
work_available: Yes - stores were buying on trade-in as of 2026-09-23. But some locations cannot pay cash at all, so call ahead before hauling gear in.
what_gets_accepted: Staff inspect the instrument in store; offers depend on condition, brand, and demand, and the store can decline items. Bring cases, cables, and accessories - completeness lifts the offer.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; no shipping since you bring gear in. Your unpaid time is the trip to the store - and confirming your location can actually pay cash before you go.
when_cash_arrives: Same-day payment after in-store inspection - up to $1,000 in cash, larger totals by check (which takes longer to clear). Confirm cash availability first; some stores cannot do cash at all.
